youtube.title: NVIDIA's board backed Jensen Huang on Sunday. He quit Thursday
youtube.description: On Sunday NVIDIA's board said it had confidence in Jensen Huang; by Thursday he had resigned. He told staff he was unfaithful to his wife, and the board probed reports he was a foreign intelligence target, which are reports, not findings. Facts checked against news reporting (NVIDIA board statement, CNBC, CNN, Al Jazeera, New York Times as reported); primary pages could not be opened.

tiktok.caption: Sunday: NVIDIA's board said it had 'confidence' in Jensen Huang. Thursday: he resigned. Four days. What did it cost NVIDIA?

publish.note: Hashtags vor dem Posten in Creator Search Insights / YouTube-Suche gegenprüfen. Reale Person, laufende Lage: Vorwürfe (Geheimdienst-Bericht der NYT, Peking bestreitet) nur als 'reports' formuliert, keine Namen Dritter, keine Spionage als Tatsache. Alle Belege nur aus Suchzusammenfassungen (Faktenprüfer Note 7, 11 Korrekturen übernommen); Stand 12.11.2026, vor Posten Lage (Q3 17.11., Anhörung 18.11.) neu prüfen. Video ist Satire, Titel/Caption bleiben sachlich. Prüfung 13.11.2026: Wochentage per Kalender bestätigt (8.11.2026 = Sonntag, Board-Statement; 12.11.2026 = Donnerstag, Rücktritt; 4 Tage); Caption ins Präteritum ('said', 'resigned'). Grund des Rücktritts nirgends behauptet.
